caption: The drawing shows three distinct objects arranged on a plain, light beige background. At the center is a large, long-sleeved garment with a collar, resembling a shirt or tunic, rendered in a vivid blue color with a repeating pattern of smaller, lighter blue motifs. Below and to the left of the main garment is a smaller version of a similarly shaped long-sleeved garment, also blue with a lighter repeating pattern, and a high collar. To the right of the main garment is a rectangular swatch of fabric in the same vivid blue, but with a different pattern of larger, lighter blue floral shapes distributed unevenly across its surface. The composition is evenly spaced, with each object clearly separated from the others against the solid background.
title: Man's Work Shirt
